sections.title: Performance Analysis — `MainActivity.kt`
sections.content:
This is a Compose/Android app, not React, so "re-renders" map to **Compose recompositions**. Here are the real issues found:

---

sections.title: 1. N+1 Pattern — Fixed 3-Second Blind Delay
2. Unnecessary Recompositions — `DashboardScreen` Reads All State Eagerly
3. Redundant Computation — Triple List Pass in `ActionItemsTile`
4. Caching Opportunity — `buildInterceptorJs()` Rebuilt on Every Page Event
5. Memory Leak — `globalWebView` Holds Stale Reference
6. Memory Leak — New `Handler` per Bridge Call
7. Memory Leak — WebView Debugging Enabled in All Builds
sections.content:
**Location:** `SourceWebView`, line 916

```kotlin
WebView.setWebContentsDebuggingEnabled(true)  // ← in all builds
```

Debug mode keeps additional V8 state alive, increases memory usage, and opens a remote debugging attack surface.

**Fix:**

```kotlin
if (BuildConfig.DEBUG) {
    WebView.setWebContentsDebuggingEnabled(true)
}
```

---

sections.title: Summary
sections.content:
| Issue | Impact | Effort |
|---|---|---|
| 3-second blind delay before Claude call | Correctness + latency | Medium |
| All-state read in `DashboardScreen` | Excess recompositions | Low |
| Triple filter pass + no `remember` | CPU on each recomposition | Low |
| `buildInterceptorJs()` rebuilt on every page event | Allocation + CPU | Low |
| `globalWebView` stale reference | Memory leak | Low |
| New `Handler` per bridge call | Allocation pressure | Low |
| Debug WebView in release | Memory + security | Trivial |
